meta.title: Neo Galaxy — A journey through the worlds of our ecosystem.
meta.description: Neo Galaxy is a constellation of projects. Discover the ecosystem and join the community.
meta.ogTitle: Neo Galaxy — A journey through the worlds of your ecosystem
meta.ogDescription: Every project is a planet. Every planet, an answer to a precise need. Explore the Neo Galaxy ecosystem.

start.title: A journey through the worlds of our ecosystem.
start.subtitle: A course charted to meet your specific needs or spark your interests. Scroll to begin the exploration and choose where to land.

intro.title: One ecosystem. Infinite touchpoints.
intro.text: Neo Galaxy is not confined to a single form, but lives in the synergy of its worlds. Every element of our ecosystem is a tangible answer to a real need: connected fragments that chart a single, grand course. From the spark of the Community to the architecture of the Software House, all the way to the guided growth of the Academy: from data to the bigger picture. Scroll to begin the journey and chart your orbit.

community.title: Neo Galaxy Community
community.description: A fantasy realm called Vaeloria, divided among peoples, alliances and territories in conflict. Create your character and become part of a collective story that the community writes together, region by region.

ngsh.title: Neo Galaxy Software House
ngsh.description: A fantasy-themed Minecraft server built for exploration, progression and cooperative survival. Dungeons to face, magic to discover and a community always ready to play together.

academy.title: Neo Galaxy Academy
academy.description: The community's moments told through videos, posts and events on social channels. A space open to those who want to experiment as creators, editors or graphic designers.

map.title: Galaxy map
map.subtitle: All the ecosystem's projects, at a single glance. Select a destination to go back and explore it.
